title: xantolis tomentosa var. elengoides
intro: Xantolis tomentosa var. elengoides, commonly known as Elengi, is a plant species within the Sapotaceae family. It is a tropical plant with reported health benefits, including its use in treating fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Xantolis tomentosa var. elengoides include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help in soothing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
